# Campaign Clippers

> Campaign Clippers is a two-sided SaaS marketplace that connects brands and
> agencies (Campaign Owners) with video clippers (creators and editors).
> Brands launch escrow-funded clip campaigns; clippers apply, submit clips,
> and are paid automatically when clips are approved.

## Key facts

- Two roles: Campaign Owners (brands/agencies) and Clippers (creators/editors).
- Escrow payments: campaign budgets are locked at launch; clippers are paid on approval.
- Reward models: CPM (per 1,000 views), fixed fee per clip, or hybrid.
- Payments: Stripe, PayPal, crypto (BTC/ETH/USDC/SOL) and M-Pesa mobile money.
- AI features: clip quality scoring, viral potential prediction, caption generation.
- Clipper verification tiers: Rising, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Elite — computed from
  real activity (views, earnings, approvals, connected accounts, ratings).
- Social connections: clippers link real social accounts (YouTube, TikTok,
  Instagram, X, Twitch, Reddit and more) with live public follower stats and
  bio-code ownership verification. Multiple accounts per platform supported.
- Pricing for brands: Starter $0/mo (1 campaign, 10% fee), Professional $49/mo
  (10 campaigns, 5% fee), Enterprise $199/mo (unlimited, 2% fee). Clippers free.
- Referral program: $10 per referred user who becomes active, plus milestone bonuses.
- GDPR compliant with one-click data export.
